title: Latkes Done Properly
author: Lenny Teytelman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baugietw

steps.title: Prepare Potatoes
steps.instruction: Wash 6 Russet potatoes without peeling them.

steps.title: Process Potatoes and Onion
steps.instruction: Chop potatoes and onion using a food processor to a size of approximately 2 mm.

substeps.instruction: Cut potatoes into large chunks and process in a food processor bowl using the chopping blade until pieces are 2 mm long; do not over-process or allow them to become liquid.
Process 1 onion in the same manner.

steps.title: Mix Ingredients
steps.instruction: Combine the processed vegetables with seasonings and flour in a bowl.

substeps.instruction: Combine the processed potatoes and onion in a bowl.
Add 1 teaspoon of salt, 1/4 teaspoon baking powder, 1/4 cup of flour, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
Taste and add more salt if necessary.

steps.title: Incorporate Eggs
steps.instruction: Add eggs to the mixture and mix well with a spoon (optional, affects texture).

steps.title: Heat Frying Oil
steps.instruction: Prepare a frying pan with canola oil heated to medium-high.

substeps.instruction: Fill the pan with oil to a depth of at least 3/4 inch.

steps.title: Remove Excess Liquid
steps.instruction: Remove water from the batter surface using a spoon by pressing it down to let liquid seep in; repeat this during the frying process.

steps.title: Fry Latkes
steps.instruction: Fry the batter in the hot oil until golden brown on both sides.

substeps.instruction: Form approximately 2 Tablespoons of batter into a round latke on a big spoon and slide it into the oil.
Fry on one side for 3-5 minutes until crisp and golden brown.
Flip and fry until both sides are golden brown.
